edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production based on information reasonably available to Defendant after a diligent inquiry. These responses are made without waiver of, and subject to, all applicable objections, privileges, immunities, and protections, including the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, and any applicable confidentiality obligations.
edits.name: Preliminary Statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it: (a) seeks information or documents protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, common-interest doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection; (b) seeks documents not within Defendant's possession, custody, or control; (c) is overbroad, unduly burdensome, disproportionate to the needs of the case, or not reasonably calculated to lead to the discovery of relevant and proportional information; (d) seeks documents already in Plaintiff's possession or equally available to Plaintiff; (e) seeks confidential, proprietary, personal, or commercially sensitive information absent appropriate protections; or (f) is vague, ambiguous, duplicative, or imposes obligations beyond those required by the applicable rules or any court order.
edits.name: General Objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing General Objections and any specific objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents within its possession, custody, or control located after a reasonable search, at a mutually agreeable time and in a reasonably usable form. Defendant reserves all objections as to the relevance, admissibility, authenticity, and evidentiary use of any documents produced.
edits.name: Production

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on the basis of privilege, work-product protection, or other applicable protection are identified in the attached privilege log to the extent required by the applicable rules. Any inadvertent production of privileged or protected material shall not constitute a waiver, and Defendant reserves the right to request return, sequestration, or destruction of such material consistent with applicable law and any governing order.
edits.name: Privilege Log

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION. Defendant's investigation and collection efforts are ongoing. Defendant reserves the right to amend, clarify, or supplement these responses as required by the applicable rules, court order, or agreement of the parties, and further reserves all rights, claims, defenses, and objections not expressly waived herein.
edits.name: Reservation

drafter.private_reasoning: Opposing counsel's points are well-taken procedurally: modern discovery rules disfavor blanket 'subject to' objections and require clarity as to withholding, timing, and form. To advance the matter, I revised the general language to preserve rights without using objections as an opaque reservation, added explicit request-by-request withholding language, a date certain for production, ESI/usability terms, confidentiality-order timing, and privilege-log timing. No confidential client bottom-line information is implicated or disclosed.

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. For each request, Defendant will state whether responsive materials are being withheld on the basis of any asserted objection.
